name: St. Regis Le Morne Resort

address.street: The St. Regis Le Morne Resort

insider_take: A luxurious sanctuary beneath the UNESCO World Heritage Le Morne Brabant mountain, where turquoise lagoons meet dramatic volcanic peaks on Mauritius' stunning southwest coast.
whats_special: The resort sits at the foot of Le Morne Brabant, a symbolic mountain that served as a refuge for escaped slaves and is now a UNESCO World Heritage site. The property features the island's largest lagoon and some of the most pristine coral reefs, perfect for world-class snorkeling and diving. The legendary St. Regis Butler Service ensures every guest receives personalized attention in this tropical paradise.
pro_tip: Book the Le Morne Suite for unobstructed views of the iconic mountain and direct beach access. The afternoon trade winds here create perfect conditions for kitesurfing - Mauritius is considered one of the world's top kitesurfing destinations.
dont_miss: Take the guided hike up Le Morne Brabant for breathtaking 360-degree views of the island, visit the nearby Chamarel Seven Colored Earths geological formation, and experience the underwater waterfall illusion viewable from helicopter tours - a natural optical phenomenon unique to this corner of Mauritius.
pros: Stunning location beneath Le Morne Brabant UNESCO World Heritage mountain
Signature St. Regis butler service and legendary hospitality standards
Direct access to pristine white sand beach with crystal-clear lagoon
World-class spa and multiple dining venues featuring local and international cuisine
Exclusive benefits through The Marriott STARS Program including room upgrades and resort credits
cons: Ultra-luxury pricing reflecting premium St. Regis brand positioning
Remote location requiring longer transfers from airport
